parent_proposals.insert_text: The [zero–subject history](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT.md#2--the-seeing-condition-becomes-a-represented-centre) **compares** this return. Gebser’s perspective history and Taylor’s P5 carry different attributions. Context here is invested participation in what a view does: disclosure can alter the judging person’s criterion and office, rather than merely add perspective metadata. The absent-Father interpretation remains Taylor’s authorial operation, not a quotation assigned to Gebser.

The [zero–subject history](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT.md#1--arithmetic-gains-a-citizen-with-exceptional-powers) **compares** this return. Arithmetic admission changes which acts the sign can perform. Colebrooke’s zero rules and retained denominator, with Dutta’s restricted-law reconstruction, give that gain specific permissions. The later symbolic return retains those powers; it does not project integral meaning into every earlier historical use or turn a theological analogy into the source of all zero arithmetic.

The [zero–subject history](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT.md#3--psychic-fact-changes-the-investigators-relation) **compares** this return. The disciplinary admission of psychic processes refracts the relation between determining capacity and its particular manifestation. Native X/x already carries that operation; neither Freud nor Jung supplies its notation. The full sequence, both inverse parents, coequal Name/Power and distinct harmonic and complementary folds remain the ground of the comparison.

The [zero–subject history](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT.md#3--psychic-fact-changes-the-investigators-relation) **compares** this return. The selected Jung CW11 §§755–757 place the God-image with the archetype of the Self while distinguishing it from the whole unconscious. These bounded psychological claims keep ego, complex, image and Self apart; they do not verify a theological event or identify all unconscious processes with native Subject. The current Aion return retains its separate selected source and symbolic office.

The [zero–subject history](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT.md#50--the-exact-sign-returns-into-accountable-practice) **compares** this return. The first advent earns an exact mathematical sign; the final advent returns that sign as living Symbol with its permissions and source relation intact. Historical witnesses retain their editions and empirical tasks while the authorial necessity of the return keeps its argued force. No ninth determination or institution appointed as achieved Subject completes this movement.

parent_proposals.insert_after: The perspectival turn **returns-to** [Con-text-through-Diaphaneity → Regard](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#con-text-through-diaphaneity) as the viewer becomes readable within the conditions of the view. Delineation-through-Difference keeps the frame and its exclusions explicit; Regard makes this disclosure consequential for judgment. More visible context can leave a measure unchanged, so the return must reach the office able to reconsider that measure. The generated relations are authorial developments with Gebser’s historical warrant kept distinct.
parent_proposals.insert_text: The [zero–subject history](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT.md#2--the-seeing-condition-becomes-a-represented-centre) **compares** this return. Gebser’s cultural account of perspective and Heidegger’s diagnosis of representation make different aspects of the seeing condition available. Their conjunction here is an argued juxtaposition, with no documented mutual influence asserted. Taylor’s contextual return concerns participation in the view’s work, preserving the source-specific histories and the native double reading.

parent_proposals.insert_after: The [myth historical development](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/encounters-and-transmissions/myth/DEVELOPMENT.md#4--aesthetic-reciprocity-becomes-a-perspective-capable-of-return) **historicises** the different offices of Nietzsche, Gebser and Taylor’s composed whole. Regard lets another centre change the criterion of seeing while preserving articulation; the separate Ovid telling retains its own cast and aftermath.
parent_proposals.insert_text: The [zero–subject history](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT.md#4--differentiation-must-carry-its-inherited-whole) **compares** this return. Neumann’s morphology of ego formation and Gebser’s consciousness structures retain different objects and historical methods. The native 180°→360° contextual turn makes first-, second- and third-person positions jointly available without adding a fourth pronoun. Communicable form can receive participation while keeping its aperture; a merged universal chronology would lose that distinction.

parent_proposals.insert_after: The [Indian philosophy dossier](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/indian-philosophy.md#50--the-next-act-must-inherit-the-return) **tests** a returned determination through its complete five-step acceptance cycle and identifies the distinct ground, generation and evaluation proposal.
parent_proposals.insert_text: The [zero–subject history](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT.md#50--the-exact-sign-returns-into-accountable-practice) **compares** this return. A local Bimba genuinely governs the bounded inquiry and remains Pratibimba relative to wider sources. A corrected source must reach the authority of that reference field, its gauge or its translation. Changing only the displayed answer leaves this return unfinished. QL’s relational grammar, MEF’s mediation and the harness’s permissions continue to perform distinct offices.

parent_proposals.insert_after: Planetary return **returns-to** [Natio and neo-nativity](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#natio-and-neo-nativity) where institutions, records and translations inherited from one circuit become another generation’s apparent starting world. Their production must remain recoverable, including whose belonging and permissions they shaped. Epi-Logos carries that history back into revised common action; federation retains locally governed grounds instead of naturalising its latest arrangement as one planetary origin.
parent_proposals.insert_text: The [zero–subject history](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT.md#50--the-exact-sign-returns-into-accountable-practice) **compares** this return. Federated epistemic return requires locally answerable worlds whose governing gauges and translations can be revised. Failure at that point is a failed test of the Offered architecture, not a completed return renamed for convenience. Disclosure of the machinery does not settle phenomenal subjectivity; the exact sign remains usable while its source relation can change the next act.
